title: Cotton Week with Morgan and Eddie Morgan
summary: He and guitarist Morgan played at McCurdy's on Canal Street.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Cotton Week? Well, Cotton Week, Morgan and I, we had McCurdy's on Canal Street. Well I used to sit on Bill's Cotton. And Gemma Street, Cotton and McCurdy's, you know, four weeks, our people played banjo and Morgan was playing a guitar, you remember Morgan? Which one of them? He used to live on General Tell Street. Morgan used to play guitar. She played guitar and I played banjo.
Well I've heard of Ike and Al and Eddie and Sam and Andrew, but he's not akin to Sam, huh? Who's that?
Morgan, no. He's not akin to the Morgan brothers at all, no, no, it was a different Morgan.
But there was Al and Eddie and Sam and-
This boy had a brother too, but his brother played sax but he never was, amounts to nothing, he wound up playing or clarinet, I mean saxophone and got to be a radio technician.
You didn't know Eddie Morgan, huh?
That's what I'm talking about Eddie Morgan. Oh, I see. The guitar player.
